items.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
items.description: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
items.description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

items.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
items.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

items.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
items.description: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

items.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
items.description: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

items.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
items.description: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

items.title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever
items.description: The 52-year-old general’s provocative posts and military threats have fuelled rumours of a dynastic succession.

items.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
items.description: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

items.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
items.description: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

items.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
items.description: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

items.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
items.description: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.
